who_bears_shortfall_or_gap: buyer for all physical supply; seller delivers certificates only
evidence: EPA GPP: unbundled RECs are sold separately from electricity, no physical delivery (C10)
status: documented by EPA; GHGP consultation proposes deliverability and hourly rules that could change eligibility (C09)

quantity_basis: MWh as generated by a named project
location_basis: same power market; off-site delivery over grid
firmness_or_continuity: no; delivery schedules and under-delivery penalties per contract
who_bears_shortfall_or_gap: buyer buys residual elsewhere; seller bears under-delivery penalties as contracted
evidence: EPA GPP: physical PPA includes power and RECs from a specific generator, usually 10-20 years, delivery schedules and under-delivery penalties (C10)

location_basis: settled at a hub or node; no physical delivery
who_bears_shortfall_or_gap: buyer bears gap between wholesale price and strike; basis risk between node and load
evidence: EPA GPP: buyer responsible for gap vs strike; electricity not delivered; REC kept by buyer (C10)
status: documented by EPA; price outcome is exactly what Module B quantifies (capture price vs hub)

quantity_basis: MWh in each hour matched to consumption
firmness_or_continuity: requires complementary resources or storage for non-solar hours
who_bears_shortfall_or_gap: buyer must contract residual hours; rules still in consultation
evidence: GHG Protocol Scope 2 consultation summary (2026-07-29): hourly matching and deliverability showed low support; second consultation planned (C09)
status: PROPOSAL, not adopted; do not treat as a customer requirement

product: Firm / continuous grid service for a large load (ERCOT 'firm' studied load)
quantity_basis: MW allocated by Load Commissioning Plan
firmness_or_continuity: firm MW defined in Batch Zero study; transmission upgrades may be needed
who_bears_shortfall_or_gap: ERCOT/TSP planning; customer commits financial security
evidence: C04 p.3-4 (Batch Zero stages; firm vs flexible); C03 p.6 (firm 107.4 GW of 125.4 GW studied in 2032)

product: Provisional Controllable Load Resource (PCLR) flexible service
quantity_basis: firm MW plus flexible MW dispatchable via SCED
firmness_or_continuity: non-firm MW curtailable ahead of full transmission build-out
who_bears_shortfall_or_gap: customer accepts dispatch/curtailment on the flexible portion
evidence: C04 p.4; NPRR1325 (C06) adds PCLR sections; 8,515 MW in 2030-2032 studied load (C03 p.6)

quantity_basis: fixed transmission withdrawal limit; on-site generation
location_basis: co-located behind the point of interconnection
hourly_match: load and generation owners coordinate so imports never exceed the limit
firmness_or_continuity: depends on on-site mix (gas 83% of BYOG MW in Batch Zero)
who_bears_shortfall_or_gap: site operators bear compliance with the limit
payment_mechanism: private network arrangements; interconnection per batch study
evidence: C04 p.5; C03 p.8 (15,444 MW generation vs 9,478 MW load)
status: official ERCOT framework; solar is 10.7% of the BYOG generation MW in Batch Zero

product: Co-location with existing generation (net metering arrangement, SB6)
quantity_basis: load netted against an existing generator
firmness_or_continuity: PUCT may condition on curtailment or capacity available to grid during events
who_bears_shortfall_or_gap: customer curtails in advance of other firm loads (ERCOT recommendation)
payment_mechanism: PUCT-approved arrangement; customers held harmless for stranded transmission
status: rulemaking (Project 58479) at the 2025-10 snapshot; later adoption not checked
